report_discrepancies.note: Governmental funds Total column: revenue lines add to 714,773, printed Total revenues 714,772 (Intergovernmental 251,266 vs General 100,645 + Street 150,622 = 251,267; Sales tax Fund revenues 164,926 vs lines 164,927). Rounding in the report.
Governmental funds Total column: expenditure lines add to 1,179,206, printed Total expenditures 1,179,207. Rounding in the report.

Governmental roll-forward from the printed lines: 2,177,910 + 714,773 - 1,179,206 - 19,786 - 79,889 = 1,613,802 vs printed ending fund balance 1,613,800 (the two total-line rounding differences above).

Proprietary Total column: nonoperating lines 58,750 + 29,558 - 16,758 = 71,550, printed Total nonoperating 71,551; roll-forward from lines gives 4,288,031 vs printed ending net position 4,288,032. Rounding in the report.

Statement of Net Position: governmental asset lines add to 2,368,791 (printed 2,368,792) and governmental net position lines to 2,367,721 (printed 2,367,722); business-type liability lines add to 913,788 (printed 913,787). Item sums: assets 7,570,610 vs printed 7,570,611, liabilities 914,858 vs 914,857, net position 6,655,753 vs 6,655,754. Rounding in the report.

General Fund departments schedule: department revenue cells add to 354,775 vs printed Total revenues 354,773 (row totals off by 1: General property tax, State assistance, Contributions, Other revenues; Library and Fire column totals off by 1). Rounding in the report.

General Fund departments schedule: department expenditure cells add to 962,823 vs printed Total Expenditures 962,821 (Personnel services row 167,896 vs 167,894; Repairs, Utilities, Other expenses rows off by 1). Rounding in the report.
Sales tax Fund revenues printed 164,926; lines 82,415 + 75,750 + 6,762 add to 164,927. Rounding in the report.
Sewer Fund total operating expenses printed 85,097; lines add to 85,095. Rounding in the report.

notes: Basic statements p1-9 (government-wide Statement of Net Position and Activities, governmental funds Balance Sheet and Revenues/Expenditures, proprietary statements and cash flows); recorded as GAAP-structured (fund balance roll-forward) although the General Fund departments schedule (p11) is titled 'modified cash basis'. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); 'Transfers in (out)' (19,786) recorded as transfers_out (Street 15,247 and Sales tax 4,539 to Electric). 'Fund balance, adjust cash opening balance' (79,889) recorded as an adjustment; same figure is the governmental restatement on the Statement of Activities. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position Total column (p7); restatement 306,006 ('RESTATED, adjust opening cash balance'). Business-type disbursements total 2,290,912 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating 2,274,154 + interest 16,758. Ending cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet cash + cash held by County Treasurer; CDs 359,624 in ending_investments; beginning cash not shown. Detail: General Fund departments combining schedule (p11), one line per department column; other funds one line per fund column of the governmental funds (p4: Street, Sales tax) and proprietary (p7: Electric, Water, Sewer, Trash, Golf) statements, as in FY2024; Cemetery recorded as health/welfare although the fund statement's public safety total appears to include it. The all-funds budgetary-basis budget-and-actual schedule (p10) is not recorded: it combines all funds (including the General Fund already on p11 and the business-type funds) in one column, so it can't be split by fund without double counting. Many printed totals differ by $1-2 from their lines (report rounding), recorded in report_discrepancies. Read pages 1-11 of 11
